summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported that Allen and Jack Knifton of Manchester had been matched to fight in England in four weeks for £200 a side and the championship of the world, in light gloves under London Prize Ring rules.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Sunday Morning, December 9, 1877

facts.fact: Allen and Jack Knifton of Manchester were matched to fight in England for £200 a side and the championship of the world, in light gloves at catch weights under London Prize Ring rules, about four weeks later

notes: Knifton described as 215 pounds, nearly six feet, the '81 tonner'
